scope_org_unit_id.purpose_comment: Historical data scope captured when the event is written (CORE-10).

hash_version.purpose_comment: V1 predates scoped audit rows; V2 commits scope_org_unit_id into row_hash.

prev_hash.purpose_comment: Set by the DB trigger — never write from the app.

row_hash.purpose_comment: Set by the DB trigger — never write from the app.

chain_seq.purpose_comment:
Hashing order, assigned INSIDE the chain trigger's advisory lock. `id`
comes from a sequence evaluated before that lock, so under concurrency the
two disagree — the chain is ordered by this, never by id.

value.purpose_comment: NULL means NOT COMPUTABLE — never conflate with zero.

respondent_hash.purpose_comment:
Salted HMAC of (poll, user) — set instead of `respondent_user_id` on an
anonymous poll so responses dedupe without storing identity (docs/03 §9).
A DB CHECK enforces exactly one of the two.

company_id.purpose_comment: C-35 scope: NULL company = whole group; plant/location narrow it further (all non-null columns must match).

penalty_evaluation.purpose_comment: SHF-01: frozen rule findings, separate from attendance/pay. NULL = not evaluated.

period_from.purpose_comment: C-17: attendance window [period_from, period_until) frozen by this lock (NULL on pre-cycle locks = calendar month).

component_amounts.purpose_comment: Monthly integer paise snapshot written by salary assignment (PAY-02).

last_used_step.purpose_comment: Replay guard — a TOTP step may be spent exactly once.

location_id.purpose_comment: NULL = held at entity level (a PF code); set = belongs to one plant.

valid_to.purpose_comment: NULL = perpetual. Never measure a perpetual registration against a threshold.

mandatory_for.purpose_comment: Comma-separated employment categories; empty = never mandatory by category.

joining_checklist.purpose_comment: Shown on the joining document checklist (REQ-004).

allowance.purpose_comment: Requested total. The ledger draws on `approved_allowance` once approved.

by_category.purpose_comment: Per-category breakdown, mirroring the live budgetReserved{} snapshot.
